text: Ayon sa kasabihan, ang hindi marunong lumingon sa pinanggalingan ay hindi makararating sa…
gloss: He who doesn't look back to where he came from will not reach... — his destination (paroroonan): the classic proverb.

text: Iba-iba man ang luto ng adobo sa bawat bahay, anong sangkap ang hindi nawawala rito at siyang dahilan kung bakit hindi ito agad napapanis?
gloss: Adobo differs in every home, but which ingredient is always there and keeps it from spoiling quickly? — Vinegar: adobo is defined by stewing in vinegar; soy sauce is common but not universal (adobong puti).

text: Kung Biyernes ngayon, anong araw ang “kamakalawa”?
gloss: If today is Friday, what day was 'kamakalawa'? — Wednesday: kamakalawa = the day before yesterday. Traps: Thursday (kahapon), Sunday (makalawa, the day after tomorrow).

text: Ang Bulkang Mayon, na tanyag sa halos perpektong hugis-apa nito, ay nasa aling lalawigan?
gloss: Mayon Volcano, famous for its near-perfect cone, is in which province? — Albay.

text: Hindi insekto ang gagamba, kaya iba ang bilang ng mga paa nito. Ilan ang paa ng gagamba?
gloss: A spider isn't an insect, so its leg count differs. How many legs? — Eight (insects have six).

text: Sa pagpipinta, anong kulay ang lumalabas kapag pinaghalo ang asul at dilaw?
gloss: In painting, what colour do blue and yellow make? — Green.

text: Tatlong dosenang itlog ang binili ni Aling Nena sa palengke. Ilang itlog lahat iyon?
gloss: Aling Nena bought three dozen eggs. How many eggs? — 36: 3 × 12. Trap: 30, the size of an egg tray.

text: Baligtarin ang pagkakabaybay ng bilang na “apat”. Anong pagkain ang mabubuo?
gloss: Spell the number 'apat' (four) backwards. Which food do you get? — Tapa: a-p-a-t reversed is t-a-p-a. Tinapa looks similar.

text: Sa kuwentong-bayang “Si Pagong at si Matsing”, anong puno ang pinaghatian ng dalawa?
gloss: In the folk tale 'The Turtle and the Monkey', what tree did the two split? — A banana tree: the monkey took the leafy top, the turtle the bottom, which grew.

text: Sa chess, aling piyesa ang gumagalaw nang pa-L at nakalulundag pa sa ibang piyesa?
gloss: In chess, which piece moves in an L and can jump over other pieces? — The knight (kabayo).

text: Napakaraming gulay ang binanggit sa awiting “Bahay Kubo”. Alin sa mga ito ang HINDI kasama?
gloss: Many vegetables are named in the song 'Bahay Kubo'. Which is NOT in it? — Bitter gourd (ampalaya). Patola, sigarilyas and mustasa are all in the lyrics.

text: Sa kompyuter na Windows, anong kombinasyon ng mga key ang ginagamit para bawiin o i-“undo” ang huling ginawa?
gloss: On a Windows computer, which key combination undoes the last action? — Ctrl+Z. Ctrl+Y is redo, Ctrl+X cut, Ctrl+V paste.

text: Noong Hunyo 12, 1898, ipinahayag ang kalayaan ng Pilipinas mula sa bintana ng bahay ni Emilio Aguinaldo. Saang bayan ito naganap?
gloss: On 12 June 1898 independence was proclaimed from the window of Aguinaldo's house. In which town? — Kawit, Cavite. Malolos hosted the later Congress; Imus is a nearby Cavite town.

text: Nagsimula ang pulong nang alas-onse y medya ng umaga at tumagal ito nang eksaktong dalawang oras. Anong oras ito natapos?
gloss: A meeting began at half past eleven (Spanish-style time words) and lasted two hours. When did it end? — Half past one in the afternoon.

text: Tinatawag na “whale shark” ang butanding at kasinlaki pa ng bus. Anong uri ng hayop ito?
gloss: The butanding is called a 'whale shark' and is as big as a bus. What kind of animal is it? — A fish: it is a shark, not a whale (mammal).

text: Sa pelikulang “The Lion King” ng Disney, ano ang pangalan ng batang leon na magiging hari?
gloss: In Disney's 'The Lion King', what is the name of the cub who will become king? — Simba.

text: Ang tokwa na ipinapares sa baboy sa “tokwa’t baboy” ay gawa sa anong butil?
gloss: The tofu (tokwa) in 'tokwa't baboy' is made from which bean? — Soybean.

text: Maraming salita natin ang hiram sa Espanyol. Anong pagbati sa Filipino ang hango sa tanong na “¿Cómo está?”
gloss: Many Filipino words come from Spanish. Which greeting comes from '¿Cómo está?' — Kumusta: hear the Spanish in it.

text: Sa isang laro ng basketball, nakapasok si Jun ng apat na tres, tatlong two-point shot at dalawang free throw. Ilang puntos ang naitala niya?
gloss: In basketball Jun scored four threes, three two-pointers and two free throws. How many points? — 20: 12 + 6 + 2.

text: Umaalis ang bus sa terminal tuwing 15 minuto, at ang unang biyahe ay alas-singko ng umaga. Ilang biyahe ang nakaalis na bago mag-alas-sais?
gloss: A bus leaves every 15 minutes, the first at 5:00. How many have left before 6:00? — 4: 5:00, 5:15, 5:30, 5:45. Autopilot gives 60 ÷ 15 + 1 = 5.

text: Iisa ang oras sa buong Pilipinas. Aling bansa sa Asya ang may kaparehong oras natin sa buong taon?
gloss: The whole Philippines keeps one time. Which Asian country shares our clock all year? — Singapore (UTC+8). Thailand and Vietnam are UTC+7, Japan UTC+9; none uses daylight saving.

text: Sa tabing-dagat, kumukulo ang tubig sa 100°C. Paano ito kumukulo sa tuktok ng isang napakataas na bundok?
gloss: At sea level water boils at 100 °C. How does it boil on a very high mountain top? — Below 100 °C: lower air pressure lowers the boiling point.

text: Aling obra ang nagwagi ng gintong medalya sa Madrid noong 1884 at ngayon ay bumubungad sa mga bisita ng Pambansang Museo sa Maynila?
options: Las Vírgenes Cristianas Expuestas al Populacho
gloss: Which work won a gold medal in Madrid in 1884 and now greets visitors to the National Museum? — Juan Luna's Spoliarium. Hidalgo's 'Las Vírgenes…' won silver that same year.

text: Itinaas ng tindero nang 50% ang presyo ng isang bentilador, saka ito ibinaba nang 50% sa sale. Kumpara sa orihinal, ano na ang presyo nito?
gloss: A fan is marked up 50%, then cut 50% in a sale. Compared with the original? — 25% lower: 1.5 × 0.5 = 0.75. Autopilot says "the same".

text: Sa “Florante at Laura” ni Francisco Balagtas, aling kaharian ang pinamumunuan ni Haring Linceo, ang ama ni Laura?
gloss: In Balagtas's 'Florante at Laura', which kingdom does King Linceo, Laura's father, rule? — Albania. Crotona is Florante's mother's homeland; Persia is Aladin's.

text: Halos tuluyan nang nabingi ang kompositor na ito nang likhain niya ang kanyang Ikasiyam na Simponya. Sino siya?
gloss: This composer was almost completely deaf when he wrote his Ninth Symphony. Who? — Beethoven.

text: Siyam na madaling-araw ang Simbang Gabi, at ang huli ay sa bisperas ng Pasko. Anong petsa ang unang Simbang Gabi?
gloss: Simbang Gabi is nine dawn masses, the last on Christmas Eve. On what date is the first? — 16 December: 16 to 24 inclusive is nine days. Autopilot gives 24 − 9 = 15.

text: Ibinalik ang Olympic Games sa makabagong panahon noong 1896. Saang lungsod ito unang idinaos?
gloss: The Olympics were revived in modern times in 1896. In which city? — Athens.

text: Ang guacamole, ang sawsawang Mehikano, ay pangunahing gawa sa anong prutas?
gloss: Guacamole, the Mexican dip, is made mainly from which fruit? — Avocado.

text: Sa salitang kalye, binabaligtad ang mga pantig: ang “idol” ay naging “lodi”. Ano ang pinagmulang salita ng “petmalu”?
gloss: In street slang syllables are flipped: 'idol' became 'lodi'. What word is 'petmalu' from? — Malupit (said 'malupet'): malu-pet flipped gives pet-malu.

text: Sa katutubong pagbilang ng Tagalog, 100 ang “sandaan” at 1,000 ang “sanlibo”. Ilan naman ang “sanlaksa”?
gloss: In native Tagalog counting, 'sandaan' is 100 and 'sanlibo' 1,000. How much is 'sanlaksa'? — 10,000 (laksa = ten thousand).

text: Animnapung kilo ang masa ng isang astronaut dito sa Daigdig. Ano ang magiging masa niya pagdating sa Buwan?
gloss: An astronaut has a mass of 60 kg on Earth. What is their mass on the Moon? — Still 60 kg: mass does not change; only weight drops to about a sixth (the 10 kg trap).

text: Sino ang nagtatag ng pahayagang “La Solidaridad” sa Barcelona noong 1889?
gloss: Who founded the newspaper 'La Solidaridad' in Barcelona in 1889? — Graciano López Jaena. Marcelo H. del Pilar later took it over as editor.

text: Anong taon ang nakasulat sa Romanong bilang na MCMXCVIII?
gloss: Which year is MCMXCVIII? — 1998: M 1000 + CM 900 + XC 90 + VIII 8.

text: Ikinasal ang anak ni Aling Nena sa anak ni Aling Cora. Ano na ang tawag ng dalawang ina sa isa’t isa?
gloss: Aling Nena's child married Aling Cora's child. What do the two mothers now call each other? — Balae (co-parents-in-law). Bilas are the spouses of siblings; hipag/bayaw are siblings-in-law.

text: Sa nobelang “Moby-Dick” ni Herman Melville, sino ang kapitang nahuhumaling na mapatay ang puting balyena?
gloss: In 'Moby-Dick', which captain is obsessed with killing the white whale? — Ahab. Ishmael is the narrator; Nemo and Flint are captains from other novels.

text: Anong pelikula ng Disney noong 1937 ang kauna-unahang buong-habang pelikulang animated ng studio?
options: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
gloss: Which 1937 Disney film was the studio's first full-length animated feature? — Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (Pinocchio and Fantasia 1940, Bambi 1942).

text: Pinagsamang “mass” (maraming tao) at Espanyol na “cara” (mukha) ang pangalan ng pistang puno ng nakangiting maskara tuwing Oktubre. Saang lungsod ito ipinagdiriwang?
gloss: A festival named from 'mass' + Spanish 'cara' (face), full of smiling masks every October. Which city? — Bacolod (MassKara). Iloilo has Dinagyang, Kalibo Ati-Atihan, Davao Kadayawan.

text: Tanghaling-tapat sa Maynila sa kalagitnaan ng Enero. Anong oras naman sa London sa sandaling iyon?
gloss: Noon in Manila in mid-January. What time is it in London? — 4 a.m.: Manila is UTC+8 and London is on GMT in winter. 5 a.m. would be summer time; 8 p.m. is the wrong direction.

text: Aling hayop-dagat ang may tatlong puso?
gloss: Which sea animal has three hearts? — The octopus. Jellyfish and starfish have no heart; a crab has one.

text: Isinilang si William Shakespeare noong 1564. Sinong siyentipiko ang isinilang din sa taong iyon?
gloss: Shakespeare was born in 1564. Which scientist was born the same year? — Galileo (Kepler 1571, Brahe 1546, Newton 1643).

text: Ang pilandok, isang maliit na hayop na kahawig ng usa, ay natural na matatagpuan lamang sa mga isla ng aling lalawigan?
gloss: The Philippine mouse-deer (pilandok), lives naturally only on the islands of which province? — Palawan (Balabac and nearby islands).

text: Karamihan sa mga elementong ito ay ipinangalan sa isang bansa. Alin ang ipinangalan sa isang buong kontinente?
gloss: Most of these elements are named after a country. Which is named after a whole continent? — Americium (the Americas). Germanium, francium and polonium honour Germany, France and Poland.

text: Sinong arkitekto ang nagdisenyo ng kumikinang na titanyong Guggenheim Museum sa Bilbao, Espanya?
gloss: Which architect designed the shining titanium Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao? — Frank Gehry. Frank Lloyd Wright designed the New York Guggenheim.

text: Sino ang may-akda ng nobelang “Mga Ibong Mandaragit”?
gloss: Who wrote the novel 'Mga Ibong Mandaragit' (Birds of Prey)? — Amado V. Hernandez. Lope K. Santos wrote 'Banaag at Sikat', Bautista 'Dekada ’70', Reyes 'Sa mga Kuko ng Liwanag'.

text: Walang titik ang pambansang awit nang una itong tugtugin noong 1898. Sino ang sumulat ng tulang Espanyol na “Filipinas” na naging unang titik nito?
gloss: The national anthem had no words when first played in 1898. Who wrote the Spanish poem 'Filipinas' that became its first lyrics? — José Palma (1899). Rafael Palma is his brother; Julian Felipe composed the music.

text: Sa baybayin, may likas na tunog na “a” ang bawat katinig. Ano ang tawag sa markang inilalagay sa itaas o ibaba nito para gawing “e/i” o “o/u” ang tunog?
gloss: In baybayin every consonant carries an inherent 'a'. What is the mark placed above or below it to change the sound to e/i or o/u? — Kudlit. Tuldik is an accent mark in modern Filipino.

text: Mga walong minuto ang biyahe ng liwanag mula sa Araw papunta sa Daigdig. Aling bagay sa kalawakan ang humigit-kumulang 1.3 segundo lamang ang layo sa atin sa bilis ng liwanag?
gloss: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach Earth. Which body is only about 1.3 light-seconds away? — The Moon: ~384,000 km ÷ 300,000 km/s. Even Venus at its closest is over two light-minutes away.

text: Bago naging hari ng burger at Chickenjoy, anong uri ng tindahan ang Jollibee nang magbukas ito noong 1975?
gloss: Before burgers and Chickenjoy, what kind of shop was Jollibee when it opened in 1975? — An ice-cream parlour (Magnolia franchise in Cubao and Quiapo).

text: Aling programming language ang ipinangalan ng lumikha nito sa isang grupo ng mga komedyanteng British?
gloss: Which programming language did its creator name after a British comedy troupe? — Python, after Monty Python.
